![Thailand Island Hopping: Ultimate Guide (2026) - Feel Free ...](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07271633-1672-0139-0000-4a47d50ee5fb:4)
`Experience the classic 10-day Andaman Sea "Phuket-Phi Phi-Krabi" route. Fly into Phuket for wild nightlife and luxury resorts. Take a 2-hour ferry to Koh Phi Phi to swim at Maya Bay, then finish in Krabi—accessible via a 1.5-hour ferry—for limestone cliffs and rock climbing at Railay Beach`.[](https://www.theblondeabroad.com/the-ultimate-guide-to-island-hopping-in-thailand/) [[1]](https://www.theblondeabroad.com/the-ultimate-guide-to-island-hopping-in-thailand/)[[2]](https://feelfreetravel.com/blog/thailand/thailand-island-hopping/)[[3]](https://www.contiki.com/six-two/article/ultimate-thai-island-hopping-itinerary/)[[4]](https://www.geekyexplorer.com/thailand-island-hopping-guide/)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DUsSUxXcE-I&t=90)[[6]](https://www.thewanderfulme.com/3-week-south-thailand-itinerary/)

Day 1–3: Phuket (Beaches & Luxury)

- **What to Do:** Unwind on Patong Beach or take a boat trip to the lesser-visited Koh Yao Yai. Spend an afternoon visiting the Big Buddha or the nearby [Phuket Elephant Sanctuary](https://www.phuketelephantsanctuary.org/).
- **Travel:** Speedboat transfers or standard ferries from Rassada Pier to Koh Phi Phi take roughly 2 hours and cost around 500–800 THB.[](https://feelfreetravel.com/blog/thailand/thailand-island-hopping/) [[1]](https://www.kuoni.co.uk/destinations/south-east-asia/thailand/krabi/tours/thailand-island-hopping/)[[2]](https://www.tropicalsky.co.uk/far-east-holidays/thailand/a-beginner-s-guide-to-island-hopping-in-thailand)[[3]](https://simbaseatrips.com/blog/phi-phi-islands/the-ultimate-itinerary-for-exploring-the-best-of-phi-phi-island/)

Day 4–6: Koh Phi Phi (Snorkeling & Partying)

- **What to Do:** This island is the hub for dramatic bays and marine life. Take an early-bird speedboat tour to Maya Bay (made famous by *The Beach* ) and Pileh Lagoon. Spend your evenings at beachside reggae bars.
- **Travel:** Ferries from Koh Phi Phi (Tonsai Pier) to Krabi (Klong Jilad Pier) take about 1.5 hours and cost roughly 400–600 THB.[](https://www.geekyexplorer.com/thailand-island-hopping-guide/) [[1]](https://kohphangan.com/andaman-islands/)

Day 7–10: Krabi & Railay Beach (Karsts & Nature)

- **What to Do:** Railay Beach is physically cut off from the mainland by massive limestone cliffs and is only accessible by boat. It is world-renowned for rock climbing and the stunning Phra Nang Cave Beach. Dedicate a full day to the 4-Island or Hong Island speedboat tours for incredible snorkeling.[](https://www.thewanderfulme.com/3-week-south-thailand-itinerary/) [[1]](https://under30experiences.com/trips/thailand)[[2]](https://www.getyourguide.com/en-gb/krabi-province-l2172/)
- **Travel:** For your return journey, Krabi International Airport (KBV) offers direct domestic flights to Bangkok to catch your connecting international flight.[[1]](https://www.ultimate.travel/southeast-asia-tours/thailand-highlights-8-day-group-tour/)[[2]](https://www.ultimate.travel/southeast-asia-tours/thailand-island-hopper-15-day-group-tour/)

Essential Travel Tips & Logistics

- **Timing:** The Andaman Sea is at its best (calm seas and dry, sunny weather) from **December to April**.[](https://www.geekyexplorer.com/thailand-island-hopping-guide/) 
- **Booking:** Use the [12Go](https://12go.asia/) platform to securely compare and book all your advance domestic flights, bus rides, and ferry crossings between islands.
- **Alternative Route:** If you are traveling between **May and September** , the Gulf of Thailand—featuring Koh Samui , Koh Phangan, and Koh Tao—offers far better weather and sea conditions.[](https://www.geekyexplorer.com/thailand-island-hopping-guide/) [[1]](https://pickyourtrail.com/tourism/thailand/thailand-island-hopping)[[2]](https://littlepassportcrew.com/thailand-with-kids/)
